about_the_game:
This is a simple RPG game independently created by an individual. Thank you very much to Freesound and Unreal. Some of the assets in the game come from this platform.

◆BEGINNER TRAINING CAMP◆

The first map that players need to go to after entering the game,defeating the monsters here has a chance to drop some basic items and equipment from them.

◆PET FUNCTION◆

Don't throw away the equipment and props obtained from monsters in the game. The store can recycle and obtain coins. After accumulating some coins, you can purchase pets in the store and obtain permanent usage rights. Pets can cooperate with players in battles, summon and retrieve pets by pressing the [C] key.

◆EXPERIENCE COPY◆

Here are small monsters with extremely high experience, which are an important way for players to level up. Killing the boss has a chance to drop the game props needed to enter this map.

◆SKILL◆

 When a player's level is raised to a certain level, new combat skills will be automatically unlocked. The higher the level, the more powerful the unlocked skills will be. Reasonable use of skills will result in a brief period of domination to avoid damage.

◆EQUIPMENT COPY◆

The difficulty of bosses in the dungeon has increased, and the probability of dropped items and equipment is higher and better. Killing the boss has a chance to drop the game props needed to enter this map.

◆DIVERSE BOSS FIGHTS◆

There are multiple boss level battle areas in the game, and the combat intensity of bosses will gradually increase as the areas deepen. It is necessary to defeat all bosses in the current area in order to open the next level.

◆EQUIPMENT CRAFT◆

Part of the materials obtained from monsters in the game can be used to synthesize advanced equipment.

◆EASY, DECOMPRESSION, FULL OF PASSION◆

"Stylite Heaven"is an adventure action game, with the biggest advantage being its simple and easy-to-use operation mode, making it easy for players to play and enjoy. The game is easy to operate, with map settings that won't get lost, no storyline, zero missions, and unlimited boss kills.

name: 修行者殿堂(Stylite Heaven)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or higher, AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (VRAM 6GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 590 (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Based on a display resolution of 1920x1080 and a frame rate of 30FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or higher, AMD Ryzen 7 5700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (VRAM 8GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Based on a display resolution of 1920x1080 and a frame rate of 30FPS

short_description: Stylite Heaven is an RPG game independently created by an individual. The concept of the game is the process of cultivators becoming stronger from weak. The unique operation mode design makes the game more interesting and easier for players to control, ensuring that every player can easily enjoy it.
